subject: Remove the pre-existing orphaned LocalDB instance directories and test scratch directories once the owner approves
description:
WHY: these resources predate journal ownership, so Loom's recovery must not claim them ("Prefix matching alone is not ownership proof", loomrefinements.md §Resource lifecycle). Deleting them is a destructive action and needs approval (decision 7).

MEASURED 2026-10-03, AMC-D-PF3XTNPM:
- 146 `loom-*` directories, 213.1 MB, under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Microsoft SQL Server Local DB\Instances (11:52:35Z), containing error.log, *.xel and *.trc only;
- 1,969 `%TEMP%\loom-ws-*` directories (11:53:17Z).

DO (orchestrator, inline, only with approval quoted here):
1. Confirm no Loom run is active.
2. `SqlLocalDB info`: each loom-* directory is either not registered or is Stopped. Delete or stop-delete the registered ones, then remove the directories.
3. Remove the %TEMP%\loom-ws-* directories.
4. Re-measure the counts and record them here.
5. Add one line to Tools/loom/Docs/ToDo.md for the workspace test-scratch leak (packages/workspace/src/testing/helpers.ts scratch()), naming its closer.

DONE WHEN: the counts re-measure as 0, or the approval is declined and that is recorded here.
activeForm: Removing orphaned LocalDB and scratch directories
